lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Volcano Spa & Resort! Five stars! The reviews say "transformative", "life-changing", and "please send help, this is not a review".

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Why does the kingdom need us HERE?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Nobody who checks in ever checks out. The spa says that's "guest retention". The families say it's "kidnapping". Semantics! Onward!

lines.speaker: Concierge
lines.text: Welcome. Your suite is ready. Your FOREVER suite.

lines.speaker: Concierge
lines.text: Nobody... passes through. There is a package for that, and you cannot afford it.
The penthouse. The floor is warm. The floor is TOO warm. The floor is the boss.

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Checking out early incurs a fee. The fee is combat. We take violence and all major currencies.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: What if we leave a good review?

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Five stars is the MINIMUM. It is also insufficient. ERUPTION PACKAGE, ACTIVATED.

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Very well... checkout... approved... minibar charges... waived...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The guests are free! Look at them stampede toward the exit in their robes! MAJESTIC.
